versions.content: After reception of each Consecutive Frame the CanTp module shall call the PduR_CanTpC opyRxData() function with a PduInfo pointer containing data buffer and data length: - 6 or 7 bytes or less in case of the last CF for CAN 2.0 frames - DLC - 1 or DLC - 2 bytes for CAN FD frames (see Figure 5 and SWS_CanTp_00351). The output pointer parameter provides CanTp with available Rx buffer size after data have been copied.
